help: Listen IP. Default loopback. A network bind requires HTTPS transport or an explicitly trusted HTTPS proxy.
Gateway port. Default 1234; valid range 1–65535. Only one service can use the selected port.
Private writable state directory. Use /var/lib/localai under systemd; never serve it as web content.
loopback keeps the health-only foundation. proxy requires trusted HTTPS peers; tls requires certificate files.
Exact canonical HTTPS browser origin, without a trailing slash. Passkeys bind to this hostname.
Comma-separated proxy IPs/CIDRs. Only these peers may supply forwarded addresses and HTTPS status. Never trust the whole Internet.
PEM certificate chain for direct TLS. Must be readable by the service. Not used with proxy TLS.
Protected PEM private-key file for direct TLS; never send it through the UI or include it in diagnostics.
